⚠⚠ **本層擋下策展層最大的一處編制錯：這不是「薩克斯風＋鋼琴」的二重奏，Lovano 在這張碟上還打鼓、敲鑼。** **Discogs 12853614 的 credits 欄逐字只有兩個演奏者，而 Lovano 那一行寫的是**：**`Joe Lovano — Tenor Saxophone [Straight Tenor Saxophone], Soprano Saxophone, Alto Clarinet, Drums, Gong [Gongs]`**，另一行 `Gonzalo Rubalcaba — Piano`。**日版 37481802 的 credits 欄逐字相同。** **→ 全張固定編制確實只有兩人（這一點策展層對了），但 Lovano 的樂器是五種：直管次中音、高音、中音單簧管、鼓、鑼。正文不得寫成「次中音薩克斯風對鋼琴」。**

**逐軌作曲（Discogs 12853614 的 per-track composed-by 欄）**：〈Flying Colors〉Joe Lovano／〈How Deep Is The Ocean〉**Irving Berlin**／〈Boss Town〉Joe Lovano／〈Bird Food〉**Ornette Coleman**／〈Spontaneous Color〉**Gonzalo Rubalcaba**／〈Phantasm〉**Paul Motian**／〈Ugly Beauty〉**Thelonious Monk**——**十二軌裡有一半以上是別人的曲子**，**正文不得寫成「兩人的原創對談」。** 其餘製作與工程欄：`Joe Lovano — Producer`、`Mark Levinson — Engineer, Mastered By`、`Kurt Lundvall — Engineer`、`Bob Defrin — Design`、`Jimmy Katz — Photography`；companies `Capitol Records — Phonographic Copyright (p)／Copyright (c)／Manufactured By`、`EMI MFG. — Glass Mastered At`。

⚠⚠ **同期紙本：Billboard 1998-01-24 第 70 頁的整則評介，標頭逐字 `*JOE LOVANO/GONZALO RUBALCABA — Flying Colors — PRODUCER: Joe Lovano — Blue Note 56092`。** 內文逐字「Tenor giant Joe Lovano and Cuban piano phenam Gonzalo Rubalcaba team up for what may be the least mainstream project for either artist. On multiple reeds, Lovano sets his inventive, often vocal-like lines into counterpoint with Rubalcaba’s … angular comping and vivacious, unpredictable solos. **Fans of the Ornette Coleman/Joachim Kühn duet set will enjoy such Ornette-reminiscent Lovano themes as the lurching, truncated "Boss Town" and the woozily pirouetting title track—not to mention Coleman composition "Bird Food."**」 ⚠ **榜欄掛名逐字是 `JOE LOVANO/GONZALO RUBALCABA`（斜線）**，與卡單的 ` & ` 形不同——**第 1303 條的順序檢查通過（Lovano 在前），斜線形是變體。**

**同期紙本第二則**：**Billboard 1998-07-11 p38 的 Blue Notes 專欄逐字**「He’s scheduled for several summer festival dates as a duo with pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba, who collaborated with Lovano for **this year’s "Flying Colors" (Blue Note)**. And music from "Trio Fascination," **due Sept. 8 (originally slated for July 28)**, will be heard when Lovano joins bassist Cameron Brown and drummer Idris Muhammad …」 **→ 同一段同時釘死本張的年份（「this year’s」＝1998）與同批 b 組《Trio Fascination》的街頭日改期（7/28 → 9/8）。**
